identity.name: BrightSmile Dental Clinic

facts.Emergency line: Call the clinic directly for emergencies (demo)

offerings.name: Check-up & Consultation
offerings.description: Full oral examination with a dentist and a treatment plan

offerings.name: Scaling & Polishing
offerings.description: Professional cleaning to remove plaque and stains

offerings.name: Braces Consultation
offerings.description: Assessment for braces or clear aligners with an orthodontist

faqs.question: Do you accept HMO?
faqs.answer: We accept selected HMOs. Please share your HMO name and our front desk will confirm cover before your visit.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Yes, we see patients of all ages, including children from 3 years old.

faqs.question: Is whitening safe?
faqs.answer: Whitening is done by a dentist after a check-up confirms it is suitable for you.
